exposure: healthcare failure mode and effect analysis method in the management of trial of labour after caesarean
outcome: Vaginal birth after caesarean section (VBAC) rate
cohort: Multiparous women in China considering TOLAC
finding: Implementation of a healthcare failure mode and effect analysis programme increased the VBAC rate without increasing the risk of uterine rupture.
mod_finding: Implementing a quality improvement program utilizing healthcare failure mode and effect analysis can increase the success rate of vaginal birth after cesarean section without compromising safety.
